sections.heading: 1. Purpose and Scope
sections.body: This System and Information Integrity Policy establishes the requirements for ensuring the integrity of {system_name} operated by {org_name}. This policy applies to all components within the system boundary described as {boundary} to protect the confidentiality and integrity of {cui_description}.

sections.heading: 2. System Flaw Remediation

questions.prompt: How are system flaws identified and reported?
What is the timeline and process for correcting identified system flaws?

sections.body: System flaws within {system_name} are identified and reported via {flaw_identification_process}. These flaws are corrected in a timely manner according to {flaw_correction_timeline}.

sections.heading: 3. Malicious Code Protection

questions.prompt: What tools are used for malicious code protection at designated locations?
How are malicious code protection mechanisms updated when new releases are available?

sections.body: Protection from malicious code is provided at designated locations using {malware_protection_tool}. These mechanisms are kept current through {malware_update_mechanism}.

sections.heading: 4. System Scanning and Monitoring

questions.prompt: What is the schedule and method for periodic system scans?
How are files from external sources scanned in real-time during download or execution?

sections.body: Periodic scans of organizational systems are performed via {periodic_scan_schedule}. Real-time scanning of files from external sources is enforced through {realtime_scan_process}.

sections.heading: 5. Security Alerts and Traffic Analysis

questions.prompt: Which sources are used to monitor security alerts and advisories?
How is inbound and outbound communications traffic monitored to detect attacks?

sections.body: Security alerts and advisories are monitored via {alert_monitoring_source}. Inbound and outbound communications traffic is monitored to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks using {traffic_monitoring_tool}.

sections.heading: 6. Identification of Unauthorized Use

questions.prompt: How is unauthorized use of organizational systems identified?

sections.body: Unauthorized use of organizational systems is identified and detected through {unauthorized_use_detection}.
